item.title: Making Postgres 300x faster for analytics: batching, operator fusion, and SIMD
item.description:
📝 When processing your SQL query, Postgres first converts your query into an internal representation called a “Query Plan,” which describes *how* Postgres will execute the query. After generating the query plan, Postgres passes it to the query engine. The Postgres query engine is the part of Postgres that takes the query plan and actually retrieves the rows and performs the aggregation.
🔗 Read more: https://malisper.me/how-we-made-postgres-hundreds-of-times-faster-the-query-engine/
